title: Tea on the Balcony
story: I sat with my morning tea and watched two birds hop along the railing. The air was cool and quiet. It felt peaceful.

title: Morning Walk in the Sun
story: I took a short walk in the sun and felt happy afterward

title: Friendly Neighbor
story: Mrs Patel waved in the hallway and left two mangoes for me. We chatted by the lift.

title: Park Walk
story: I took a slow walk to the park bench. Ducks waddled by and a child giggled. I took three deep breaths.

title: Grandpa’s Lentil Soup
story: I cooked lentil soup the way Grandpa taught me—onions first, then cumin. The house smelled like Sundays.
